questions.question: What was Pixar’s first feature film?
questions.note: 1995, directed by John Lasseter. It was also the first fully computer-animated feature.

questions.question: Who played Spider-Man in Sam Raimi’s 2002 film, the first of that trilogy?
questions.note: Garfield is the Amazing Spider-Man films; Holland is the MCU. Kirsten Dunst is Mary Jane.

questions.question: What is the first James Bond film starring Daniel Craig?
questions.note: 2006, a series reboot. Die Another Day was Pierce Brosnan’s last Bond film.

questions.question: Who played Wolverine in X-Men (2000), the character’s first live-action film?
questions.note: Bryan Singer directed. Reynolds later played Deadpool; Schreiber is Sabretooth in X-Men Origins.

questions.question: Who voices Woody in the Toy Story films?
questions.note: Allen is Buzz Lightyear. Hanks’s brother Jim sometimes covers Woody in video games and shorts.

questions.question: Who directed the first Twilight film (2008)?
questions.note: Weitz did New Moon; Slade did Eclipse; Condon did the two Breaking Dawn films.

questions.question: Who directed the first X-Men film (2000)?
questions.note: Ratner directed The Last Stand; Vaughn directed First Class.

questions.question: What is the subtitle of Star Wars: Episode I, released in 1999?
questions.note: Liam Neeson, Ewan McGregor, and a young Anakin. Attack of the Clones is Episode II.

questions.question: Who played adult Anakin Skywalker in Attack of the Clones and Revenge of the Sith?
questions.note: McGregor is Obi-Wan. Lloyd played Anakin as a boy in The Phantom Menace.

questions.question: In which year was the first Pirates of the Caribbean film released?
questions.note: The Curse of the Black Pearl, with Johnny Depp, Orlando Bloom, and Keira Knightley. Gore Verbinski directed.
